feeds.title: Deidre Joyner Blog
feeds.description: The Oakland Berkeley Journal Blog belongs to realtor Deidre Joyner. Deidre is currently the top-performing agent at Red Oak Realty, closing over $69M in sales in 2021. She is in the top 0.3% of real estate agents for a number of transactions in the Inner East Bay. Her listings are on the market for an average of just 16 days.

feeds.title: Julie Gardner Blog
feeds.description: Julie Gardner has been writing The Perspective for 18 years and has published more than 670 essays on life and real estate. She is a wife, a mother, a REALTOR, a community volunteer, a weekly blogger, a philanthropist, a comic at heart, a flea-market junkie, a serial renovator, a 'before-and-after' specialist, and a prolific chocolate-chip cookie baker.

feeds.title: Bruce Wagg Group Blog
feeds.description: My family and I have been intimately involved in the Oakland and Piedmont community for generations, with a portfolio of successful businesses. We have provided professional service to generations of families throughout the years. Explore my Oakland Real Estate adventures with Piedmont neighborhood stories, history, architecture, and homes.

feeds.title: Red Oak Realty
feeds.description: Read articles on real estate, the economy, featured agents, foreclosures, neighborhoods, buying & selling, and more. Red Oak is one of the largest independent real estate brokers in East Bay. It is an inherently local and personal business.

feeds.title: LOH SISTERS Blog
feeds.description: Jillian & Jennifer Loh were born and raised in Oakland real estate. The LOH SISTERS are the East Bay's triple-designated Certified Commercial Investment Member (CCIM), Certified Property Manager (CPM®) & Broker Associates with LOH Realty & Investments and Wellington Property Company. Today, the LOH SISTERS are REALTORS® & accredited brokers with a market legacy in multifamily brokerage and property & asset management throughout the East Bay. Our mission is to transform lives through multifamily real estate.

feeds.title: Munmon Real Estate Blog
feeds.description: My name is Randy Munmon, and I'm a real estate professional, property manager, and Owner of Munmon Real Estate. I have over fifteen years of experience in the real estate industry. We are an independent brokerage based in Oakland, CA, providing real estate services to homeowners and home sellers in the San Francisco Bay Area.

feeds.title: Joe Dickerson Group Blog
feeds.description: At the Joe Dickerson Group, real estate is our jam. We live and breathe it, and we could talk your ears off about nerdy real estates things like negotiation tactics, inspection contingencies, and more. Take a look at our Oakland and East Bay real estate blog to get the latest news on home buying, and selling in Oakland, and real estate investing opportunities.

feeds.title: Kim Cole Real Estate Blog
feeds.description: We are an award-winning, small-but-mighty team working together to deliver results. We have built a strong, supportive culture rooted in collaboration and community. Our success is a team effort, and our environment is harmonious. We are passionate about the work we do, often working together for clients, or simply offering each other support in their individual efforts.
